candidates.name: LLM training loss-spike and checkpoint-divergence early-warning service
candidates.bottleneck: Frontier-model training runs lose days of wall-clock to loss spikes that current detection (gradient-norm thresholds, EMA smoothers) catches only as the spike commits; no parameter-free baseline against which to declare a run healthy.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: Under stable AdamW with WSD schedule and warm-restart-free LR, inter-spike-interval CV across the second half of pre-training clusters within plus-or-minus 15% of 1/(2*pi) ~= 0.159 across architectures; runs that go on to crash show monotone CV broadening crossing 1/(2*pi) at least 200 optimiser steps before the terminal spike.
candidates.natural_buyer: Frontier-model labs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, Mistral, AI2, Cohere, ByteDance, Alibaba, xAI). Procurement via enterprise contract or paid tier on top of an open-source v1 plug-in to W&B / MLflow.
candidates.falsifier: A regulator-stabilised training run (Class B by KL-clip / weight-decay) showing CV above 1/(2*pi). Fastest negative test: compute inter-spike-interval CV on the public Pythia and OLMo training logs and check class ordering against the tightness of their explicitly applied stabilisation.

candidates.name: Predictive maintenance directional-baseline library for rotating machinery
candidates.bottleneck: Vibration-analytics market currently fits per-plant CV thresholds from history; cross-fleet comparison impossible without recalibration; false-alarm rates high; lead time variable.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: On the IMS Bearing test-to-failure dataset (Bearing 3 inner race, Bearing 4 roller), inter-spike-spacing CV crosses 1/(4*pi) at least 12 hours before the published failure timestamp; healthy CV across the run-in 36 hours sits within plus-or-minus 20% of 1/(4*pi).
candidates.natural_buyer: SKF, Siemens Industrial, GE Vernova, Schaeffler, Bently Nevada (Baker Hughes), AspenTech, OSIsoft (AVEVA); end-asset operators (utilities, refineries, wind operators).
candidates.falsifier: A Class C bearing run (active cavitation injected) returning CV below 1/(4*pi) on the IMS test bench. Fastest negative test: re-analyse PRONOSTIA dataset bearings 1_3 through 1_7 with class labels and check ordering.
data_sources: Case Western Reserve Bearing Data Center

candidates.name: Wearable cardiac three-class triage (HRV directional baseline)
candidates.bottleneck: HRV indices on consumer wearables are calibrated per-user; cross-user comparison unreliable; recovery score opaque; no parameter-free reference scale below the level of named-disease detection.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In 24-hour resting-state RR sequences, healthy-adult inter-beat-interval CV clusters within plus-or-minus 20% of 1/(4*pi); endurance-trained cohorts tighten by 20-40%; documented atrial-fibrillation cohorts widen above 1/(2*pi).
product_layer_vocabulary: predictive precision under cardiovascular Markov-blanket regulation
candidates.natural_buyer: Whoop, Oura, Polar, Garmin, Fitbit; secondary: Apple Health partners, telehealth platforms (Hims, Teladoc), corporate-wellness vendors.
candidates.falsifier: An endurance-trained cohort showing CV above the healthy-resting cohort, both stratified by age. Fastest negative test: PhysioNet rank-sum on healthy vs CHF vs AF cohorts, reproducing the canonical B2 protocol.

candidates.name: RL training-stability instrumentation (PPO / DPO / GRPO Class A vs B)
candidates.bottleneck: RLHF / DPO / GRPO training is famously unstable; existing tools (KL-divergence, reward variance, ELO) report state but offer no parameter-free criterion for regulated vs drift-toward-collapse; reward-hacking is detected after damage.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: On TRL-trained PPO runs of sub-10B models with default hyperparameters, KL-divergence CV across optimisation steps clusters near 1/(2*pi); enabling KL-clip moves CV to 1/(4*pi) plus-or-minus 20%; observed reward-hacking collapses raise CV by at least 1.5x before final divergence.
product_layer_vocabulary: stability monitoring under bounded KL precision
candidates.natural_buyer: Same labs as candidate 1; additionally Vercel-AI / open-source RL framework maintainers (TRL, OpenRLHF, Tunix, verl).
candidates.falsifier: A KL-clipped run (Class B) showing CV above an unclipped run (Class A) on the same task. Fastest negative test: rerun the open TRL examples with and without KL-clip and compare CV ordering.

candidates.name: Tokamak ELM precursor / disruption-prediction service
candidates.bottleneck: ITER-relevant tokamaks need pre-emptive ELM detection but current neural-network classifiers (BES-ELMnet, DIII-D ConvNets) are dataset-specific and lack a parameter-free cross-machine baseline; Type-I ELMs at ITER scale would damage divertor tiles within seconds without mitigation.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In DIII-D BES inter-ELM-interval traces at fixed pedestal pressure, Type-I H-mode CV sits within plus-or-minus 15% of 1/(4*pi); RMP-suppressed shots show CV at most 0.02; pellet-pacing brings CV below 1/(4*pi) by 30-50%.
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy precursor diagnostics for high-confinement plasmas
candidates.natural_buyer: ITER Organization, EUROfusion, Commonwealth Fusion Systems, Tokamak Energy, TAE Technologies, Helion, General Fusion, UKAEA, PPPL, ASDEX-Upgrade collaboration.
candidates.falsifier: An RMP-suppressed shot returning CV above the Type-I baseline, holding pedestal pressure fixed. Fastest negative test: re-analyse DIII-D 2018-2024 RMP campaigns with class labels.

candidates.name: Space-weather Hale-cycle anchored forecasting service
candidates.bottleneck: NOAA SWPC and ESA SSA solar-cycle predictions fit nonlinear regression to historical SSN and vary by model; satellite operators (Iridium, Starlink, polar airlines) lack a parameter-free reference for orbit-decay budgeting and radiation-dose planning.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: SC25 + SC26 paired Hale CV computed at end-of-2030 falls in the band [0.075, 0.085]; SC25 minimum-amplitude departures from 1/(4*pi) by more than 15% indicate Class C transition implying lower operational confidence.
candidates.natural_buyer: NOAA SWPC contractors (Lockheed Martin Space, Ball Aerospace), ESA SSA, satellite operators (Iridium, SpaceX Starlink, OneWeb, Eutelsat), polar-route airlines (Air New Zealand, Cathay Pacific), space-weather insurance (AXA Climate, AON parametric).
candidates.falsifier: Completed SC25 (year 2030) Hale CV outside the [0.075, 0.085] band. Fastest negative test: rolling SC25 north-hemisphere CV update at every annual SILSO release.
data_sources: WDC-SILSO sunspot archive (Royal Observatory of Belgium)

candidates.name: Power-grid frequency-stability anomaly detector for high-renewables grids
candidates.bottleneck: ENTSO-E continental Europe inertia is falling as fossil units retire; Project Inertia Phase II identifies an increase in scenarios where |RoCoF| exceeds 1 Hz/s post-split; synthetic-inertia services exist but lack a parameter-free directional metric for sufficient regulation.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In synchronously-connected segments with greater than 70% inverter-based generation and less than 0.5 GVA*s per MW inertia, inter-excursion-interval CV widens above 1/(2*pi) compared with a less-than-30% IBR baseline; reversion under synthetic-inertia services tightens CV back below baseline.
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy excursion detection for power systems
candidates.natural_buyer: ENTSO-E TSOs (50Hertz, Eirgrid, National Grid ESO, RTE, Terna, Statnett, TenneT), NERC reliability coordinators, Hitachi Energy, GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, ABB grid-stability product lines.
candidates.falsifier: A high-renewables grid (Eirgrid 2024+, South Australia) showing CV below a low-renewables comparator under matched load. Fastest negative test: ENTSO-E transparency-portal frequency data, segmented by SNSP, classified.

candidates.name: CAT-bond / parametric-reinsurance pricing engine
candidates.bottleneck: The 2025 CAT-bond market is at $61.3B outstanding with $25.6B issued in 2025; pricing depends on dataset-specific historical fits; parametric triggers (~7% of issuance and growing) lack a single cross-peril dispersion benchmark.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: Atlantic-hurricane parametric-trigger inter-arrival CV in 1990-2025 HURDAT2 lies above 1/(2*pi); Pacific-basin (different substrate) sits in a directionally distinct cluster; the ordering is invariant under re-binning at 5, 10, 20-year windows.
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy parametric-trigger pricing under structural-uncertainty priors
candidates.natural_buyer: Munich Re, Swiss Re, Hannover Re, RenaissanceRe, AXIS, Everest Re; ILS managers (Twelve Capital, ILS Capital, Schroders Capital, Stone Ridge); structurers (Aon Securities, Guy Carpenter, GC Securities).
candidates.falsifier: Atlantic-basin trigger CV ranking below Pacific-basin under same-magnitude trigger threshold. Fastest negative test: Artemis CAT-bond DB historical-trigger inter-arrival CV computed by basin and ordered.
data_sources: Artemis CAT bond and ILS deal directory

candidates.name: Atrial-fibrillation onset early-warning module
candidates.bottleneck: Existing AF prediction is dominated by black-box ML on HRV features needing cohort-specific tuning, with PPV ranges varying by population; no parameter-free directional baseline.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In the pre-AF 90-minute window in PhysioNet AFDB, RR-CV trajectory is monotone and crosses 1/(2*pi) at least 30 minutes before onset in at least 70% of episodes; reverses on successful sinus-rhythm restoration.
candidates.natural_buyer: AliveCor, iRhythm (Zio), Boston Scientific (LUX-Dx), Medtronic (LINQ II), arrhythmia clinics, AF-screening telehealth.
candidates.falsifier: Pre-AF CV trajectory not monotone, or absence of class shift in annotated pre-AF segments. Fastest negative test: AFDB rank-sum on annotated pre-AF segments.

candidates.name: Quantum-error-correction logical-qubit cycle diagnostic
candidates.bottleneck: Below-threshold confirmation in surface-code experiments (Google Willow 2024, IBM 2025 multi-round) currently relies on observing logical-error-rate decreasing with code distance; no parameter-free baseline at which inter-logical-error CV settles, so below threshold is empirical-fit-relative.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In Willow d=3,5,7 surface-code experiments with logical-error-rate published, inter-logical-error-interval CV at d=5 and d=7 lies within plus-or-minus 25% of 1/(4*pi); above-threshold d=3 shows CV broadening above.
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy diagnostic for surface-code logical qubits
candidates.natural_buyer: Riverlane (UK QEC stack vendor with Deltaflow / Deltakit, natural integration partner), IBM Quantum, Google Quantum AI, OQC, Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum.
candidates.falsifier: An above-threshold d=3 logical qubit showing CV at or below the d=7 baseline. Fastest negative test: re-analyse Willow public syndrome traces and check class ordering.
data_sources: Google Willow surface-code public syndrome traces

candidates.name: Gait-clinic Huntington's / Parkinson's destination triage
candidates.bottleneck: Gait analytics in HD / PD trials currently report direction (worsening or stable) but lack a quantitative endpoint for how far regulation has collapsed; trial endpoints lean on cohort-fit rates of change.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In pre-symptomatic HD gene carriers within 5 years of motor onset, stride-CV trajectory regresses linearly with UHDRS-TMS toward 1/(4*pi); rate of approach correlates with CAG-repeat length (r > 0.4).
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy biomarker under cortico-basal-ganglia precision loss
candidates.natural_buyer: HD-clinic centres-of-excellence (Roche / Wave Life HD trials, Triplet), Cure HD Initiative, MJFF Parkinson's; gait-analysis vendors APDM (Clario), Mobility Lab; trial-endpoint CRO partners (IQVIA, Parexel).
candidates.falsifier: HD gene carriers with longer CAG repeats showing slower CV approach to 1/(4*pi) than shorter-repeat carriers, holding age constant. Fastest negative test: re-analyse PhysioNet gait DB for Hausdorff cohorts with CAG annotation.

candidates.name: Sleep-stage transition timing for PSG and consumer sleep
candidates.bottleneck: Sleep-stage scoring is rule-based (R&K / AASM); transition-timing distributions are descriptive but not anchored; consumer wearables compute deep-sleep minutes without a directional health prior.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In SHHS healthy-adult cohort, inter-N3-N2 transition CV across the night clusters within plus-or-minus 20% of 1/(2*pi); moderate-to-severe OSA cohorts show CV at least 1.4 times healthy; CPAP-adherent users have CV within 1.1 times healthy.
candidates.natural_buyer: Philips Respironics, ResMed, Compumedics, Natus; consumer sleep tech (Eight Sleep, Whoop sleep, Oura sleep, Withings).
candidates.falsifier: Severe-OSA cohort CV at or below healthy cohort, holding age and BMI constant. Fastest negative test: SHHS / MESA NSRR rank-sum on stratified cohorts.
data_sources: Sleep Heart Health Study (SHHS) via NSRR
Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) via NSRR

candidates.name: Battery thermal-runaway precursor monitor
candidates.bottleneck: Thermal-runaway precursor detection is dominated by impedance-spectroscopy heuristics tuned per chemistry; cross-pack baseline comparison is poor; field-event prediction lead times vary widely.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In NREL Li-ion abuse-test cohorts, healthy-cycling impedance-spike CV clusters within plus-or-minus 25% of 1/(4*pi); precursor cells show monotone CV broadening crossing 1/(2*pi) at least five charge-discharge cycles before thermal event.
candidates.natural_buyer: Tesla, BYD, CATL, LG Energy Solution, Northvolt, Form Energy, Fluence, Wartsila; BMS-chip vendors (Analog Devices, NXP, Texas Instruments).
candidates.falsifier: Pre-runaway cell CV trajectory non-monotone or precursor cells indistinguishable from healthy at cycle-50 ahead. Fastest negative test: re-analyse NREL battery DB abuse-test cohorts.
data_sources: NREL Battery Performance and Health Database
Stanford-MIT battery cycling dataset (Severson et al.)

candidates.name: Additive-manufacturing layer-defect monitoring
candidates.bottleneck: AM process monitoring (in-situ photodiode, acoustic, thermography) reports state but lacks a parameter-free baseline for in-spec; per-machine fits are required.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In NIST AM Bench laser powder-bed-fusion under nominal Ar atmosphere, inter-spatter-event CV clusters at 1/(2*pi) plus-or-minus 20%; oxygen-rich excursion (at least 2% O2) drives CV broadening above 1.4 times baseline within 50 layers.
product_layer_vocabulary: in-process anomaly detection with directional baselines
free-energy process-control diagnostic for additive manufacturing
candidates.natural_buyer: GE Additive, EOS, Trumpf, Carbon, Velo3D, Markforged, SLM Solutions; aerospace operators (GE Aviation, Airbus); medical-device printers.
candidates.falsifier: A Class C contamination experiment showing CV at or below baseline. Fastest negative test: NIST AM Bench artefact-cohort CV ordering.

candidates.name: Financial market regime-shift early warning
candidates.bottleneck: Vol-regime change detection (HMMs, Markov-switching, GARCH) is widely available but tuned post-hoc to historical regimes; pre-flip directional warnings carry edge but degrade as competitors adopt the same techniques.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In S&P-500 daily realised volatility 2000-2025, inter-VIX-spike CV across 5-day rolling windows widens monotonically by at least 1.3x across the 10 windows preceding documented regime-shift dates (2008-09-15, 2020-03-09, 2022-02-24).
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy regime-shift detection for systematic strategies
candidates.natural_buyer: Hedge funds (Two Sigma, Citadel, Renaissance, Man AHL, AQR), bank risk teams, MSCI risk products, Bloomberg / Refinitiv quant terminals.
candidates.falsifier: Pre-regime-shift windows showing CV non-monotone or below baseline. Fastest negative test: open TAQ data with 5-day rolling CV across documented regime-flip dates.

candidates.name: Speech-pause dementia screening for telehealth
candidates.bottleneck: Speech-based cognitive screening (Linus Health, Canary Speech, Cogniciti) is deep-learning-driven and needs cohort-specific tuning; no parameter-free directional baseline.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In DementiaBank Pitt cookie-theft narratives, healthy-control inter-pause CV clusters at 1/(4*pi) plus-or-minus 25%; AD cohort widens to at least 1.4 times healthy; MCI cohort sits in between with directional ordering preserved.
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy precursor under cortico-bulbar precision loss
candidates.natural_buyer: Linus Health, Canary Speech, Ellipsis Health, Cogniciti, NHS dementia-pathway services; insurance telehealth (Cigna, Aetna).
candidates.falsifier: AD cohort CV at or below healthy in Pitt corpus, holding age constant. Fastest negative test: DementiaBank Pitt rank-sum on healthy / MCI / AD cohorts.

candidates.name: Anaesthesia-depth burst-suppression directional baseline
candidates.bottleneck: BIS index and SedLine are proprietary spectral indices; neither offers a directional class scale; inter-patient variability is significant; anaesthetists titrate to BIS but lack a class-shift indicator distinct from index value.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: At MAC approximately 1.0 sevoflurane in MIMIC-IV / OASIS-B EEG records, inter-burst CV crosses below 1/(4*pi); awake baseline above 1/(2*pi); deep suppression below 0.05.
candidates.natural_buyer: Medtronic (BIS), Masimo (SedLine), Mindray, GE Healthcare, Drager, Philips Healthcare.
candidates.falsifier: Deep-suppression cohort showing CV above awake-cohort. Fastest negative test: MIMIC-IV / OASIS-B retrospective cohort rank-sum.

candidates.name: Semiconductor manufacturing process-control overlay
candidates.bottleneck: SPC + Cpk in fabs is per-tool, per-process; cross-fab benchmarking is hard; modern AI-enhanced SPC products accelerate detection but still rely on dataset-specific fits.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: Under nominal NXT-class scanner operation (recipe-anonymised), inter-overlay-residual-spike CV clusters at 1/(4*pi) plus-or-minus 20%; chuck-temperature drift induces Class C broadening crossing 1/(2*pi) at least 50 wafers before the current Cpk threshold trip.
candidates.natural_buyer: ASML (virtual-metrology partner), KLA, Lam Research, Applied Materials, Tokyo Electron; fabs (TSMC, Intel, Samsung Foundry, GlobalFoundries).
candidates.falsifier: A deliberate chuck-thermal-drift experiment that fails to produce CV broadening before Cpk threshold. Fastest negative test: partner-fab retro-data on chuck-thermal logs.
data_sources: Mostly proprietary; partner fab data required for v1

candidates.name: Continuous-EEG seizure-onset early warning
candidates.bottleneck: Seizure-prediction algorithms struggle with per-patient calibration and high false-alarm rates; FDA-cleared products do detection not prediction.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In Mayo / NeuroVista chronic ECoG, inter-spike CV in the pre-ictal hour is monotone and crosses Class C threshold within 60 minutes for at least 50% of seizures; postictal Class B reversal in at least 70%.
candidates.natural_buyer: NeuroPace (RNS), Epitel (REMI), Ceribell, Beacon Biosignals; epilepsy monitoring units; epilepsy-trial CROs.
candidates.falsifier: Pre-ictal CV trajectory not monotone above per-patient baseline. Fastest negative test: NeuroVista public dataset re-analysis.

candidates.name: EEG-aging dementia screening (band-redistribution diagnostic)
candidates.bottleneck: EEG dementia biomarkers (beta/theta ratio, alpha-rhythm slowing) are descriptive; no parameter-free directional baseline; cohort-fit thresholds vary by study.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In HBN / Cuban Human Brain Project data, beta/theta ratio CV across 5-min eyes-closed segments rank-orders cohorts (cognitive-reserve-high < healthy-aging < MCI < AD), with all pairwise comparisons p < 0.05 under FDR.
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy spectral diagnostic for prodromal dementia
candidates.natural_buyer: Cognito Therapeutics, Linus Health, Brainscope; Eisai diagnostic partners (Lecanemab patient-flow); NHS dementia-pathway services.
candidates.falsifier: AD-cohort beta/theta CV at or below healthy-aging cohort, controlling for age. Fastest negative test: HBN cohort rank-sum.

candidates.name: Insulin-pump closed-loop controller diagnostic
candidates.bottleneck: HCL pump tuning relies on per-user CGM history; cross-pump benchmarking is descriptive (TIR, GMI); over-aggressive PID drives oscillation but no directional baseline at which well-tuned is defined.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: Inter-bolus CV on Tidepool open-source pump community data clusters at 1/(4*pi) plus-or-minus 20% for users with TIR > 70%; over-aggressive PID parameter regimes show CV broadening above 1/(2*pi) with corresponding GMI deterioration.
product_layer_vocabulary: free-energy controller-quality biomarker for type-1 diabetes
candidates.natural_buyer: Tidepool open-loop community first (no FDA path needed), then Medtronic Diabetes, Tandem, Insulet, Beta Bionics partner. The Tidepool bypass is the strategic value here.
candidates.falsifier: TIR-stratified Tidepool cohorts showing no CV ordering. Fastest negative test: Tidepool open-data CV by TIR-stratum.
data_sources: JAEB Center for Health Research diabetes datasets

candidates.name: Aircraft / fleet structural-health fatigue triage
candidates.bottleneck: Aircraft SHM is regulator-driven (FAA / EASA airworthiness); long certification cycles; data heavily proprietary; buyer-side procurement multi-year.
candidates.preregistered_prediction: In FAA-LTBP-equivalent fleet histories, inter-crack-event CV under nominal A320 / 737 family operations clusters at 1/(4*pi); operator-induced harsh-landing histories (at least 2.0 g threshold breaches per 1000 cycles) drive CV broadening above 1/(2*pi).
candidates.natural_buyer: Boeing, Airbus, IATA member airlines via Sabre / Ramco; MROs (HAECO, AAR, ST Engineering); ICAO research.
candidates.falsifier: Harsh-operator fleet showing CV at or below benign-operator fleet. Fastest negative test: anonymised fleet-history paired comparison from one airline-customer pilot.
data_sources: FAA NDS / AAIB / NTSB occurrence reports

Highest mathematical fit (5/5) of any commercial candidate; SO(2)->Z2 canonical fingerprint; mature buyer market with $5B+ existing budget category.
Direct realisation of B2 PhysioNet canon; public data carries v1; low capital, fast SDK / licence path.

top_3_medium_pilots.rationale: Highest defensibility (5/5) across the candidate set; beauty-peak architecture maps directly to ITER's <100 ms prediction horizon.
Direct realisation of P1 canon; 22-year cycle baseline publishable on open SILSO data with falsifier resolving at SC25 end (2030).
SO(2)->Z2 canonical, named TSO buyers, regulatory pathway grid-code certification (manageable); macro tailwind from ENTSO-E Project Inertia Phase II.

top_2_strategic_bets.rationale: Tidepool open-source pump community gives a regulator-bypassed v0 path that proves the directional-CV class diagnostic before any FDA engagement; if directional ordering survives, OEM market follows.

Slow regulator path but band-redistribution canon (B5 lineage) carries distinctive directional ordering across cognitive-reserve cohorts; dementia-pathway services pay for screening that selects responders to disease-modifying drugs (Lecanemab class).
